name: Chrysler Imperial CL Phaeton 1932
description:
1932 Chrysler Imperial Custom, series CL: the LeBaron-bodied 146 in wheelbase flagship. This is the dual-windshield sport phaeton (rear screen lowered): 14 shipped in 1932. 384.8 cu in L-head straight eight with nine main bearings and Floating Power mounts: 125 bhp at 3200 rpm. Multi-Range four-speed, 4.10 axle, vacuum-assisted hydraulic drums, beam axles on semi-elliptic springs, 7.50-17 tyres on wire wheels, twin side-mounted spares, 5065 lb.

3D model: "Chrysler 1932 CL Imperial" by klaxoneer (https://sketchfab.com/klaxoneer), CC BY 4.0 - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/chrysler-1932-cl-imperial-13fa6aedfe9e4a688a8e86a8d2d98a96 - modified by Street Corsa Mods.

Driver pose, animations and collider box: Kunos Simulazioni.
